en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear. Dialect forms 'че' (that), 'ко' (as/when), 'је' (her) are my reading. 'Без коски и душа' is literally 'without bones and soul'.

lines.en: One evening I dreamed a dream
that a female friend
appeared to me like a light
above my bed.
When I saw her I was frightened,
the dead girl was alive,

lines.cyr: таа ме праша кај е љубовта
lines.lat: taa me praša kaj e ljubovta
lines.en: she asked me where the love is
that used to be inseparable.

lines.cyr: Еј другару, збори, не плаши се
lines.lat: Ej drugaru, zbori, ne plaši se
lines.en: Hey friend, speak, do not be afraid

lines.cyr: јас сум без коски и душа
lines.lat: jas sum bez koski i duša
lines.en: I am without bones and soul
tonight I came to you

lines.cyr: до два збора да ти кажам јас.
lines.lat: do dva zbora da ti kažam jas.
lines.en: to tell you a couple of words.

lines.cyr: Над гробот мој, ил' на крстот
lines.lat: Nad grobot moj, il' na krstot
lines.en: Over my grave, or on the cross
or on my gravestone
when you walk, take care
expect to find something.
You will find that ring

lines.cyr: кој што ми го даде ти,
lines.lat: koj što mi go dade ti,
lines.en: that you gave me,
you will take it and bury it
far away in some desolate place.
